# Kalislav Smirnov, DevOps Engineer and Aerospace Engineer

> DevOps engineer with 4.5 years of experience in Kubernetes, GitLab CI/CD, Ansible and Terraform, most recently for banks and government agencies, including fully air-gapped environments. Also integrates SAST, DAST and SCA scanning into pipelines. Aerospace engineer by degree (Bauman Moscow State Technical University, spacecraft design; SolidWorks, KOMPAS-3D, ANSYS, MATLAB, Simulink). Based in Tbilisi, Georgia, relocating to Košice, Slovakia. Open to offers now: full-time as an employee, B2B or contract; a job in Košice first (needs a work permit such as the EU Blue Card), elsewhere in the EU, or remote work for a company in any country.

Book a 20-minute intro call: https://cal.com/kalikys/intro

Contact: kalikys@outlook.com · Telegram @kalikys · https://www.linkedin.com/in/devops-kalislav-smirnov/ · https://github.com/kalikys
